games/hardware-test/game.conf:
# Hardware Test game settings. Changes take effect when the game is restarted.
id=hardware-test
name=Hardware Test
description=CRT colour, motion, audio, input, and capture checks
module=build/games/hardware-test.so

box_width=168
box_height=120
speed_x=2
speed_y=1

# Assets are ordinary files relative to the Chirky repository root.
pattern=games/hardware-test/assets/colour-bars.ppm
bounce_sound=games/hardware-test/assets/edge-beep.wav

# RGBerry's PWM/SCART audio appears as bcm2835 Headphones on ALSA card 0.
sound_device=plughw:0,0
snapshot_dir=snapshots

games/phosphor-run/game.conf:
# Launcher metadata
id=phosphor-run
name=Phosphor Run
description=Restore the last signal in a collapsing broadcast tower
module=build/games/phosphor-run.so

# Editable game assets
content=games/phosphor-run/content.conf
# Optional campaign starting level (zero-based); editor playtesting overrides remotely.
start_level=0
sound_device=plughw:0,0
sound_jump=games/phosphor-run/assets/jump.wav
sound_dash=games/phosphor-run/assets/dash.wav
sound_shard=games/phosphor-run/assets/shard.wav
sound_checkpoint=games/phosphor-run/assets/checkpoint.wav
sound_death=games/phosphor-run/assets/death.wav
sound_win=games/phosphor-run/assets/win.wav

# Fixed 60 Hz movement tuning. Edit and use Save + reload in the dashboard.
move_accel=0.34
max_run_speed=2.35
ground_friction=0.72
air_drag=0.95
gravity=0.34
max_fall_speed=5.80
jump_speed=5.35
coyote_frames=7
jump_buffer_frames=7
dash_speed=6.20
dash_frames=8
camera_lag=0.12

# Six-digit RGB colours
background=050a14
deep_machinery=091a2b
platform=163c55
platform_edge=35d7d3
phosphor=9cff57
amber=ffb43b
hazard=ff5b4f
paper=f4f1cf
games/rosey-chop/game.conf:
id=rosey-chop
name=Rosey Chop
description=Chop the dead roses before the storm - dodge the wasps
module=build/games/rosey-chop.so

# Level one - time values are in seconds, at 60 updates per second.
storm_seconds=75
wasp_interval_seconds=8
wasp_duration_seconds=6
sound_device=plughw:0,0
